messages:
elena: Heads up — runtime 3.2 landed to staging earlier. Canary flagged a regression on long-sequence runs for quantized llama3 variants. Thoughts on pin vs rollback?

deploybot: Canary digest: https://deploys.redwood/canaries/1747200000 — overall green except longseq-stress showing ~8% failure.
mike: digging into traces: kernel-selector picked a new quant execution path, p99 token latency up ~22% on p3 for sequences >2048. Memory churn during KV warmup spikes.
ryan: sounds like a selector heuristic change. I prefer soft-pin on affected model cohort while we ship a selector-fix hotpatch to avoid broad rollback.
elena: Agreed. Proposal: apply runtime pin to runtime=3.1 for model_glob=llama3q-quant* on staging+canary cohorts. Create hotfix branch that tightens selector scoring and add smoke tests for longseq path.
jin: I'll schedule monitoring and block unpins in the 01:00-05:00 UTC change window. If error-rate >=5% OR median token latency >=20% vs baseline, escalate to incidents and execute rollback playbook.
mike: PR created with diffs and smoke job: https://git.redwood/runtime/pulls/1747201 — added a deterministic selector unit test and tracing.
deploybot: Applied pin at 1747201200: { pinlist: [{ runtime: "3.1.0", models: ["llama3q-quant*"], reason: "kernel-selector drift -> longseq regressions", owner: "eng-runtime" }] }
ryan: For release notes: add a compatibility advisory: "Long-sequence workloads on quantized llama3 variants may see performance changes under runtime 3.2. Pin to 3.1 for stability." Recommend support ticket template.
elena: I'll draft the ops note and release-notes blurb. Decision: soft-pin applied, hotfix PR in review, prod unpin blocked until canary validates. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
